direct_cuts: Fees as lead-allocation weight: the 1.5x repeat weighting can be farmed by self-dealing accounts; starves new and low-fee providers
sfumato_cuts: Lead tick: 2-account wash farming whenever tick value exceeds the fee; biased against new providers
Prestige: penalizes legitimate repeat clients; sybil rings defeat the diversity metric
Live clearing: surface metaphor for dynamic pricing; gives incumbents an information edge
red_team.sfumato_wildcard: Utilization insurance: moving clients off-platform lowers bookings, which triggers priority demand (inverted incentive). Fix: trigger on a market-level index, not individual bookings

results.direct_champion: Risk-pooled liquidity/credit rail: the platform or a partner lender advances supplier pay and lets clients pay later or in installments; limits are priced only off verified on-platform history, which also serves as bank-recognized income proof
results.sfumato_champion: Pod succession: a recurring client is bound to a 2-4 provider pod (primary + shadow) sharing a context ledger; the shadow rotates in periodically and takes over instantly on absence or exit; cancelled slots are refilled; an off-platform deal can only take one provider

blind_ab.reason: Direct belongs to the embedded-finance category (lower novelty) but builds credit history on the supply side that cannot be replicated off-platform; the pod is the most novel, but the primary must cede revenue to the shadow, which risks team-wide defection and adds ops complexity.

blind_ba.reason: The pod moves relationship ownership from one provider to a team plus ledger, far from the cliches; direct resembles existing embedded finance (Faire / Shopify Capital), its limits can be inflated with wash trades, and it is weak for small-ticket categories.

results.outcome: split_tie: each judge preferred the slot-A candidate (position bias); aggregate +2 sfumato; sfumato scored higher on novelty in both orders (8 vs 5-6), direct higher on practical impact (7 vs 5-6)

direct_cuts: Default half-life: adverse selection against accurate docs that cannot be executed (ADRs, concept docs); one-click quarantine invites griefing; git blame misattributes

red_team.sfumato_wildcard: 'Wrong' mark as page: open to page spam and false reports. Fix: dedupe pages and require the executed command or log

results.direct_champion: Claim-level code anchors + probes: a merge that breaks an anchor marks the sentence Contested, names the breaker and routes reader questions to them (fix / re-sign / retire); the sentence folds after N days; ADRs carry metric valid_while predicates
results.sfumato_champion: Consumer-registered flank probes: downstream teams that depend on a claim register probes (symbol anchor, nightly sandbox exec, metric existence); 2 or more distinct angles = defended, otherwise grey dead ground; failures alert the dependent consumers first

blind_ab.reason: Making the breaker pay, plus folding and valid_while, closes the loop; registering consumer probes is itself public-goods labor, and the alerts do not charge whoever caused the break.

blind_ba.reason: Anchors + routing to the breaker + valid_while make false docs evict themselves; consumer probes protect teams that are already diligent and leave grey dead ground, so the impact is smaller.
